AppsPage.attributionSuffix: , an independent, community-curated Docker app template from github.com/Squidly271/community.applications. Templates are not vetted by this project. Review the container's ports, volumes, and image before installing.

BrowsePage.fileConflictLegend: File exists on multiple disks - please fix
BrowsePage.fileConflictTooltip: File exists on multiple disks ({{locations}}) - please fix
BrowsePage.emptyFolder: Folder is empty. Drag files here, or use Upload.

DockerPage.title: Docker Containers
DockerPage.updateDialogDesc: Pulls the newer image and recreates this container with its existing config. It'll be briefly unavailable while it restarts.

HistoryPage.title: History
HistoryPage.liveDesc: Live - updating as new data arrives, last 10 minutes
HistoryPage.rangeDesc: CPU, memory, network, and per-disk temperature/read-write/usage over time
HistoryPage.waitingForLive: Waiting for the first live sample…

SharesPage.title: Pools
SharesPage.desc: A pool is a unified folder spanning one or more disks to store files.

UsersPage.title: Sharing
UsersPage.sharesDesc: Turn on SMB or NFS access for a pool (created on the Pools tab), and grant per-user permissions below.
UsersPage.noPools: No pools yet - create one from the Pools tab first.
UsersPage.pendingImportHeading: Imported from Unraid, awaiting a password
UsersPage.pendingImportDesc: These accounts were found during an Unraid import. Set a password for each one to actually create it, or remove it to discard.

SetupPage.subtitle: Create the account to finish setup.

about.title: About
about.rebootDesc: Reboots the host. The array stops and unmounts cleanly first, then Docker, LXC, Samba, and NFS all stop too. This page reconnects automatically.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageDesc: Only English is available for now.

array.title: Array
array.turboWriteDesc: Faster writes but at the expense of more power draw. All HDD drives must be spun up. Best for large transfters, rebuilds, and parity checks.
array.spinDownDesc: Spin down HDD data and parity disks when no activity. Boot disk is not affected.
array.reloadDriverPromptDesc: Only use this if you know what you're doing!

cache.title: Cache
cache.useCacheDesc: Writes to the cache mirror first. A scheduled mover then drains cache onto the array below. Speeds up read/writes since parity isn't used.
cache.autoMoverDesc: Moves everything from cache onto the array.
cache.runMoverDesc1: Moves cache onto the array now.
cache.runMoverDesc2: A file that's currently open (e.g. by a running Docker container) is skipped rather than failing the whole run.
cache.runMoverDesc3: Stop anything actively using cache-hosted paths first for a complete move.

dockerLxc.title: Docker & LXC Storage
dockerLxc.appLinkHostDesc: Host used for a Docker/LXC app's "Open" link (an IP, or a name like nonraid.lan) - leave blank to use whatever address loaded this page. Set this if you access the dashboard through a reverse proxy: a container's own port usually isn't reachable at the proxy's own domain, so links built from it break. Doesn't include the port - that's still detected per app.
dockerLxc.dockerStorageDesc: Location of docker system and image file storage.

shares.title: Pools
shares.minFreeSpaceDesc: When a pool spans multiple disks, a disk with less free space than this will not be written to. the default is 4GB.
shares.minFreeSpaceError: Enter a non-negative whole number of GBs.

backups.title: Local Backups
backups.autoBackupDesc1: Backs up Samba/NFS config, this app's settings/pools/shares/users, the array superblock, and Docker config.
backups.retainError: Number of backups to keep, or check "Keep all backups forever".
backups.destDiskError: Pick a disk for the destination.
backups.backUpNowTooltip: Creates a backup and stores in currently-configured destination directory.
backups.downloadCopyTooltip: Backup config and download to your browser
backups.downloadEncryptedCopyTooltip: Backup config and download to your browser. Password encrypted.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.restoreConfigDesc: Restore NonRAID's settings/pools/shares/users, Samba/NFS config, and if no array exists - the array superblock.
recovery.recoverArrayDesc: Restores only the array superblock, i.e. disk assignments and parity configuration. Settings will not be restored.
recovery.importDescPrefix: Migrate the disks and configuration from a previous NonRAID or Unraid array in directly, using a
recovery.importDescSuffix: superblock file rather than a config backup.
recovery.recoverArrayWizardTitle: Recover the array from an uploaded file
recovery.cliDecryptPrefix: To decrypt an encrypted backup without the webui use
recovery.cliDecryptSuffix: from a terminal - see its --help for usage.
recovery.importUnraidTitle: Import shares and users from Unraid
recovery.importUnraidDesc: Bring over share definitions and user accounts from an Unraid install's config/ directory - an archive (.tar, .tar.gz, .zip) or a whole folder.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.appriseToggleDesc: Turn on/off notifications services from apprise.

security.title: Security
security.trustProxyDesc: Only enable if using a reverse proxy to reach this backend. Make sure to set the trusted addresses, otherwise all are trusted.
security.trustProxyAddressDesc: An IP, CIDR range, or hostname for the reverse proxy itself. Only forwarded headers arriving via this address are trusted; left blank, any hop is trusted once the toggle above is on. Multiple addresses can be comma-separated.
security.changePasswordDesc: Also signs out every other session.
security.stepUpDesc: Changing your password signs you out of all sessions.
